mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.role_code AS code, r.role_name AS name, r.description AS description, r.status AS status, r.version AS version, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permissionCount

ORDER BY r.role_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=BIGINT}

mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE sys_role SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE role_code IN
